headline: COP31 fails to reach consensus on Antalya Pact
summary: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference failed to reach consensus on the proposed Antalya Pact, COP31 President Murat Kurum said. The closing plenary came after a third draft text was released nearly two days late.
why: UN climate conference outcomes shape long-term policy expectations for energy, carbon pricing and clean-technology investment across global markets.
